proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9187 bahu explicitly gives Awan bàũ and Lahnda bahũ much/many, alongside western bo(h) forms. Pothwari baõ many fits this contracted quantity family with loss of intervocalic h and source o/nasalisation retained. The local vowel outcome is a qualification, not an exact dictionary quotation; Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: baõ.
